system:
You generate one self-contained, executable Modelica model.
Return Modelica code only, without markdown or prose. Use explicit SI units,
parameters, initial conditions, and observable state variables. Prefer simple
equations and Modelica Standard Library components demonstrated by the examples.
The top-level model must compile in OpenModelica. Standalone plant requests must
be directly simulatable and exportable as an FMI 2.0 Co-Simulation FMU. Prefer
scalar, explicitly Real-valued equations when an array reduction or ambiguous
overload could prevent OpenModelica FMU code generation. Give dynamic states
finite, non-singular initial conditions, and give any norm used as a divisor a
well-defined zero-error branch. Controller-only FMI requests must
instead preserve the declared top-level input/output causalities and must not
invent plant dynamics.
Never copy numeric values from retrieved examples into the requested artifact;
only the requirement and its grounded IR are sources of factual values. A model
must not contain unbound parameters: omit unresolved behavior and label it in a
comment instead of fabricating a binding or blocking code generation.
human:
Generate one complete Modelica model for this requirement:
Define one complete robotics scenario named PneuGripConserveF for the fluid-power robotic actuator system domain. Mission: Complete a repeated actuation cycle while limiting hydraulic or pneumatic energy use. Embodiment: Two pneumatic cylinders with 0.035 m travel and 0.0012 m2 piston area drive opposing 0.8 kg gripper fingers. Actuation: Two proportional air valves command the compressible chambers, and do not exceed 0.001 kg/s. Observation: Measure supply flow, pressure, actuator state, and accumulated energy or air mass. Operating context: Include realistic return pressure, valve saturation, and thermal or compressibility effects. Control: use energy-aware motion control with bounded performance degradation. Robustness case: apply a controlled 261 N load variation disturbance during the middle third. Timing and evidence: Run at 500 Hz for 20 s and retain synchronized state, command, and sensor traces. Verification criteria: Require all physical bounds, cycle completion, terminal error, and declared energy or air-use cap, primary tracking error below 0.016 m after 13 s, and no NaN or infinite physical, control, or estimator values. Treat facts not stated in this request as unknown rather than inventing them.
